analysis:
Examined base_text units of docs/provider/cli-reference.md, lines 1-821. These are documentation-only changes.

The changes in the visible patch:
- Line 3 updates the date.
- Line 52 (head) adds 'constant or variable frame rate' to the GLM inline video description. This is documentation of media decoding. T-050 covers inline video plaintext in temp files; the doc claim does not by itself change any control. The VFR handling implementation in the GLM media path was not supplied, so it cannot be verified that VFR decoding avoids temp-file writes per T-050.
- Head line 1578 adds a documented file, ~/.darkbloom/verified-weights.json (DARKBLOOM_VERIFIED_WEIGHTS_FILE, 0600). It is described as holding managed GLM load hashes bound to file identities, reused for startup registration (VerifiedWeightHashStore.swift). This is security-relevant to T-012/T-027 (operator weight substitution, A-004).
  - It is an operator-writable cache of verified hashes, reused at registration.
  - If the binding to file identity (inode/mtime/size) is weak, an operator could swap weights while preserving identity and register a stale verified hash.
  - The env override also lets the path be redirected.
  - The implementation is not in this batch, so this is an unverified contract, not a finding. Integration should check VerifiedWeightHashStore.swift for:
    - identity binding strength (device/inode/size/mtime/ctime);
    - nofollow/owner checks;
    - whether the reused hash affects coordinator routing trust or only local performance.
  - Note: weight hashes are already self-reported (T-012 notes operator can replace weights), so a regression is unlikely beyond existing accepted risk.
- Head line 1604 change was not visible in these units.

The remaining base text (cache, logout, switch, schedule) is unchanged context; no regression identified there.
